name: Hymns of the Holy
description: Work with the Lumbridge Church to get a new holy song from the Entrana Monks.
rewards: Level up and play the Organ

name: A Noteworthy Duel
description: Melodine, the music tutor, had her Recorder of Guided Notes stolen by a goblin. Find Tootfang the Goblin and challenge him to a Musician's duel to get Melodine's Recorder back.

name: Welcome to the White Knight Parade
description: Help Sir Roundson organize a White Knight Parade for the city of Falador!

name: Electric in my Soul
description: Work with musical engineers in Dorgesh-Kaan to discover how to electrify string instruments.
rewards: Learn how to play electric string instruments
Learn how to change string instruments into electric string instruments

name: Windward Whistle
description: The local guards want to enhance their warning whistles and emergency calls for potential Ogre attacks. Wizard Maestrum, the local legendary bard who imbues instruments with magic, will help you fulfill the request.
rewards: Wizard Maestrum teaches you how to add wind-imbued mouthpieces to your Wind instruments

name: Thump it Real Good
description: Thuddley, an ogre, has discovered that using different sticks can change the sounds of percussion instruments. Help Thuddley create the perfect Thudding Sticks for the best Thudding Duel Gu'Tanoth has ever seen.
rewards: Access to Thudsticks and Thudmallots, which increase performance score when using a percussion instrument

name: Fiddlin' with Fire
location: The Deeper Lode Tavern in Lovakengj
description: A musician has accidentally summoned a powerful Demon fiddler. You must battle and defeat them in the art of music.

name: Conductive Reasoning
description: Help the woodwinds, the percussionists, the string section, and the conductor at the college put everything together for the Bard's College GRAND Orchestra.
rewards: Ability to perform with the Bard's College Orchestra
A permanent additional 2% exp boost to your performance score whenever you perform with other players
